buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Tender AU-90970A for supply of Cationic Polyacrylamide Pre-Qualification Criteria: A. EXPERIENCE CRITERIA: a. PO copy of Similar water treatment chemicals Cationic Polyacrylamide (Dewatering Polymer) supplied during last Seven years ending last day of month previous to the one in which applications are invited b. Relaxation in Experience criteria for eligible MSEs/ STARTUPS 1. For MSEs- Relaxation of 25% in prior experience shall be provided to the qual ifying MSEs. 2. For Startups – As detailed in Benefits for Start Ups (page 12-13 of attachmen t). Following documents shall be required to demonstrate experience in completion of similar items / works / services: 1. Copy of the Purchase Order (PO) / Work Order / Contract for the supply of similar items / works /services shall be issued and executed within the last seven (7) years. 2. Proof of execution of the submitted PO, which may include any of the following: a. Completion certificate / Customer Acceptance Certificate OR

b. GeM CRAC (Consignee Receipt and Acceptance Certificate) document OR c. (i). Tax Invoice to the extent of required Pre-Qualification value and (ii). Proof of receipt of payment like bank statement for the above referred tax i nvoice. The document submitted as proof of execution must be specifically for the same c oncerned Purchase Order (PO)/Work Order/Contract submitted, clearly indicating t he corresponding PO/Work Order/Contract number. 3. Only PO No/Contract no. is to be given if any Vendor has supplied the material t o RCF B. MAKE IN INDIA CLAUSE: As per revision dt 19.07.2024 of ‘Public Procurement polic y 2017’, Non-local suppliers cannot participate in tenders having estimates less than R s. 200 crores. Offers of Class-I and Class-II Local suppliers as per Make in India pol icy can only be considered for evaluation and award of contract. Technical Conditions: 1 2 MT/ 2000 KG Cationic Polyacrylamide (Dewatering Polymer) +/-25% Cationic Polyacrylamide (Dewatering) 2 Polyacrylamide 90% Appearance - White crystalline powder Total solid 88% -90% (W/W) pH (0.1% solution) - 3.0 to 5.0 Bulk Viscosity (0.1% solution) - 25 to 50 cPS If any deviation is found in the technical specifications mentioned herein, the material shall be li 3 able for rejection Terms & Conditions / Technical Requirements: 1. The Bidder/Supplier shall supply the material in a staggered manner. RCF shall intimate the Bidder/Supplier regarding the requirement and delivery schedule. 2. The Bidder/Supplier shall deliver the material within 7 days from the date of intimation b y e-mail from the concerned RCF Officer. First delivery shall consist of 03 MT of Anionic Polyelectrolyte (used in HRSCC) and 01 MT of Cationic Polyacrylamide (Dewatering Poly mer). 3. The Bidder/Supplier shall be responsible for the proper performance and effectiveness o f the supplied chemical in the RO/ETP system. If required, the Bidder/Supplier may colle ct water/effluent samples from the ETP during the bidding period for testing and evaluat ion and shall quote accordingly, considering the characteristics of the effluent and the r equired treatment performance. 4. All materials shall be supplied on suitable wooden pallets to facilitate safe handling, sto rage and movement at RCF Thal. 5. The Bidder/Supplier shall provide a Test Certificate/Certificate of Analysis (CoA) issued b y a NABL-accredited laboratory along with each supply. 6. Material received at RCF Thal shall be inspected by RCF Thal. RCF representatives will dr aw samples and analysis will be carried out at RCF’s laboratory. The results obtained at RCF’s laboratory will be final and binding. The consignment shall be rejected if it does n ot meet the PO specification. 7. The Bidder/Supplier shall provide the applicable Material Safety Data Sheet (MSDS) alon g with each supply.

8. The supplied chemical shall be used within the specified permissible consumption limits under normal operating conditions of the plant. The allowed chemical consumption shall be as follows: Allowed Consumpti Sr. No. Chemical Unit on Limit 1 Dewatering Polymer for Centrifuge Kg per day 4 In case a higher chemical dosage/consumption is required for satisfactory plant operation, the a dditional chemical consumption cost attributable to such excess consumption shall be recovere d/deducted from the Bidder/Supplier’s bill, as per the terms and conditions of the Purchase Orde r/Contract. 9. The Bidder/Supplier shall take back all empty plastic bags supplied by them after each su bsequent delivery. 10. Payment shall be made on the 30th day from the date of acceptance of the material by R CF, subject to submission of all required documents and compliance with the applicable t erms and conditions of the Purchase Order. There will be deduction if late delivery will be found as after due date of intimation. 11. The material shall have a minimum shelf life of one (1) year from the date of receipt at R CF Thal. 12. Anionic Polyelectrolyte and Cationic Polyacrylamide is required for the operation and mai ntenance of the ETP Upgradation Plant installed at RCF Thal Unit. The ETP Upgradation Pl ant comprises Oil & Grease Trap, Flash Mixer, HRSCC, Centrifuge, Multi Grade Filter (MGF ), Ultrafiltration (UF) and Reverse Osmosis (RO) systems. 13. Tolerance: Overall quantity tolerance of ±25% shall be applicable to the total quantity of chemical covered under the Purchase Order. 14. Contract validity – 1 Year from the date from the date of Purchase Order. 15. The quantity of chemical mentioned in the tender/PO are approximate and indicative qua ntity only. RCF does not guarantee procurement of the entire quantity mentioned in the t ender/PO. Payment shall be made only for the actual quantity of chemical supplied and a ccepted at RCF Thal. No payment shall be made for the balance/un-supplied quantity. 16. The pH of the solution shall be measured as per IS 3025, and the viscosity shall be measu red on a Brookfield make viscometer. 17. ETP Upgradation Plant Inlet Design Parameters: Sr. No. Design Parameter Unit Design Value Effluent Temperature – 1 °C 35 Maximum Effluent Temperature – 2 °C 25 Minimum 3 pH — 6 to 8 4 TDS ppm 2500 4 5 TSS ppm 300

6 COD ppm 100 7 BOD ppm 50 8 Conductivity µS/cm 3500 9 Total Hardness ppm 500 10 Calcium Hardness ppm 250 11 Phosphates ppm 15 12 Turbidity NTU 50 13 Iron ppm 1 14 Ammoniacal Nitrogen ppm 30 Total Kjeldahl Nitrogen ( 15 ppm 40 TKN) 16 Free Ammonia ppm 20 17 Sodium ppm 300 18 Potassium ppm 40 19 Chloride ppm 275 20 Sulphate ppm 300 21 Silica ppm 50 22 Total Alkalinity ppm 320 23 Nitrate ppm 75 24 Methanol ppm 15 The desired RO permeate quality is as follows: Sr. No. Design Parameter Unit Desired/Design Value 1 pH — 6.8 to 7.7 2 Conductivity µS/cm 61 to 150

3 Total Hardness ppm 22 to 66 4 Calcium Hardness ppm 12 to 32 5 M-Alkalinity ppm 14 to 50 6 Phosphates ppm Not Traceable 7 Chloride ppm 10 to 20 8 Turbidity NTU 1.5 9 Iron ppm 0.015 to 0.16 10 Silica ppm 11 to 26 11 Sulphate ppm 1 to 10 Weighment: 7 Weighment will be done at RCF weighbridge and net weight recorded at RCF weighbridge or wei ght mentioned in the party’s invoice, whichever is less will be final and binding for all purposes. Packing of Material: Material should be neatly packed in Drums / HDPE Bags and shal l be palletized for transportation and handling. Material should be properly wrapped/ packed on pallets so as to ensure that Drums /bags don’t fall from the pallets while u 8 nloading Please note material will not be unloaded and may lead to rejection if not palletized. 9 Tolerance +/- 25% Integrity pact: RCF has accepted and agreed to the terms and conditions of the Integrity Pact. The Bidder, as a token of acceptance of the terms and conditions of the Integrity Pact will sign and stamp t he Integrity Pact and submit the same with NIT documents. Signing the Integrity Pact is a prerequisite for prequalification and Integrity Pact and NIT conditions will for m part of the contract.
